name: Demo G4: Delete-Like Redline Family Instance
description: Exercise a delete-like redline operation using a disposable modeled family-instance target: create a bounded device/fixture-like element, prove its requested type and visibility, delete it with native dry-run/apply evidence, prove it is absent, and write a deterministic visual gate.
setup_instructions: Open a disposable Revit model or a model that can be closed without saving.
Use a view, level, and non-hosted or level-hosted family type that can be safely placed and deleted.
Prefer a generic annotation, receptacle, light fixture, or other disposable benchmark symbol available in the active model.
success_criteria: A disposable family instance id is created in the model.
The native create result returns family/type/name evidence matching the requested disposable symbol.
The created family instance id is visible in the pre-delete visible-element inventory.
Native delete dry-run and apply effect evidence include the created family instance id.
The post-delete visible-element inventory no longer contains the family instance id.
A deterministic delete visual gate artifact passes using before/after capture evidence.
failure_criteria: The family instance is not created or is created as a different requested type.
The pre-delete visible-element inventory does not contain the created family instance id.
Delete dry-run or apply omits the family instance id from effect evidence.
The post-delete visible-element inventory still contains the family instance id.
The delete visual gate artifact is missing or fails.
grader_notes: This task generalizes delete-like redline evidence beyond text and tags into actual modeled family instances.
Do not count requestedIds-only delete responses as evidence; delete must return ids, deletedIds, or impactedIds.
